Company Announcement

Taylor Farms of Dallas, Texas is recalling H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kit due to the potential undeclared soy and tree nuts(almonds).

People who have sensitivity or allergy to soy and tree nuts(almonds) may be at risk of a serious adverse reaction if they consume this product. To this date, there have been no reported adverse reactions to this product.

The recalled product was distributed to H-E-B stores located in Texas and has the Best If Used By date October 30, 2026. The recalled product is packaged in plastic bags and can be identified by the Best If Used By date and UPC code below:

STORE

Salad Kit 13.4 oz

Customers who purchased the products should not consume the items. Impacted products should be disposed of or returned to the store for a full refund.

Customers with questions may contact Taylor Farms at (855) 455-0098 Monday through Friday between 8am and 4pm PST.

Media: press@taylorfarms.com
